# Another Nord

Another Nord applies a Nord-inspired colour scheme of cool blue-grey tones with gentle contrast. Syntax highlighting stays readable and interface accents remain subtle across panes, which the recorded description frames as a calm writing environment.

![Another Nord screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qanszer/another-obsidian-nord-theme/HEAD/dark.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Another Nord"
    author: "qanszer"
    repo:   "qanszer/another-obsidian-nord-theme"
    slug:   "another-nord"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/another-nord"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/qanszer/another-obsidian-nord-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qanszer/another-obsidian-nord-theme/HEAD/dark.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a Nord-inspired color scheme with cool blue-gray tones and gentle contrast. Maintain readable syntax highlighting and subtle UI accents across panes for a calm, focused writing environment."
}
```
